app.name: Tuner
app.description: Online strobe tuner with automatic note detection, manual targets, and reference pitch calibration. Audio stays on your device.

tuner.title: Tuner
tuner.needleDial: Needle tuner: minus 50 to plus 50 cents, flat to the left, sharp to the right, centered when in tune; beyond the scale the needle stays at the edge, refer to the offset reading
tuner.dial: Two strobe rings rotating together, with twice as many blocks on the outer ring: flat rotates counterclockwise, sharp rotates clockwise, matching pitch approaches a standstill
